verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is a self-hosted platform (not itself an agent), so the axis of 'ships an official MCP server for external agents to connect to' applies, but the evidence only shows Open WebUI acting as an MCP *client* (calling tools exposed by external MCP servers, docs-27, docs-32) — there is no documentation of Open WebUI exposing its own official MCP server endpoint for other agents to connect to.
